messages:
leo: Heads up — prod-eu GPU pool autoscaler did not add nodes for ~12m after this morning's firewall baseline tweak. Pods stayed Pending with keystore errors.
ops-bot: deploy: firewall/eu-baseline rolled by alice at 2026-03-22T23:45Z (change-id ch_20260322_fw_eu_12) :warning:
leo: Error from node init logs: ```2026-03-23T00:01:12Z keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: "KMS Grant not valid for caller"
stack: keystore-proxy->privatelink-proxy->kms-endpoint (eu)```
nisha: ugh. that was the rule that tightened outbound to the privatelink IP range, right? we scoped it down to the mgmt subnet.
mike: yep, fw rule limited ephem privatelink egress to 10.1.32.0/28 and dropped the shared NAT path. we wanted to stop noisy telemetry but overlooked keystore proxy talk.
julian: quick triage — can we add an allow for the keystore privatelink IPs or open the NAT path for keystore-proxy service-account? rolling that should let nodes pull grants.
alice: I pushed the change to infra/ops but wanted approval for the exception. security-bot: Note: any allow will increase auditable egress. add to runbook and tag compliance.
leo: short term we need an exception to get warm pools back. long term we need an explicit keystore flow test in the firewall pipeline.
mike: workaround plan: 1) add allow for privatelink CIDR 10.1.32.0/28 -> temporary 2) trigger warm-pool drain/replace 3) monitor keystore decrypt success. cost: cross-region fallback to usw2 would have let traffic flow but egress + perf hit.
nisha: I'd prefer exception to the fw rule vs cross-region shift — less customer-visible impact. I'll own the change if security signs off.
security-bot: Checklist before exception: 1) justify + TTL 2) audit log entry 3) monitor added 4) post-mortem assignment.
julian: run commands I ran to confirm (from bastion): ```curl -sv https://keystore-eu.privatelink.redwood.internal/health -> SSL handshake ok
openssl s_client -connect keystore-eu.privatelink:443 -servername keystore-eu
# then observed KMS grant failures once connection established```
leo: action: @nisha add a temporary fw allow for 10.1.32.0/28, TTL 2h, add audit tag `keystore-emergency-20260323`. add to runbook: https://runbooks.redwoodinfra/internal/eu-keystore-egress
ops-bot: policy-change-request: #2345 created by nisha (expires 2026-03-23T02:30Z)
alice: I'll standby for rollback permission if anything odd.
mike: monitoring checks added: `keystore.decrypt_success{region="eu"}` and `gpu.pool.warm_nodes.count`. will alert on <90% decrypt success or warm_nodes < target.
leo: FYI this exposed a cost tradeoff — to avoid similar outages we can either loosen egress policies (small monthly natgw/egress cost) or add per-service privatelink endpoints (capex + operational overhead). would like a short doc with cost numbers.
nisha: noted, I'll draft an ops-vs-privatelink cost memo after stabilization.
julian: postmortem owner: @leo, runtime fix owner: @mike, security sign-off: @alice.
security-bot: Reminder: attach KMS grant audit logs to the incident record and include KMS key id in the PM.
leo: thanks. after TTL we'll re-evaluate and either harden with more specific rules or schedule endpoint work. :thumbsup:
